title: Family Day at Hastings Contemporary
summary: A half-term family day stepping back nearly 1,000 years to explore the story of 1066.

title: Spooky Science at the Observatory Science Centre
venue: Observatory Science Centre & Museum, Wartling Road, Herstmonceux
summary: A daytime Halloween visit, with a Spooky Science Show, a Bewitching Bat Trail and shocking electricity exhibits, running through half term.

title: Ghost Tours at Herstmonceux Castle
venue: Herstmonceux Castle Estate, Wartling Road, Hailsham
summary: Herstmonceux Castle's ghost tours run for three nights this October: guided evening tours exploring ghost stories and reported sightings, with much of the building in darkness. Tours last at least an hour, with just 30 places on each.

title: Charity Quiz Night at The Mermaid Inn
summary: Charity quiz night in the Tudor Room, with tickets £5 per person and tables of up to six to reserve. Halloween fancy dress is optional and earns extra points.

title: Brede Farmers' Market
summary: The weekly Friday market with local produce, crafts, baked goods and a refreshment cafe.

title: Voodoo Fest
venue: Lord Nelson pub, the Bourne, Hastings Old Town
summary: A Mardi Gras style Halloween procession with a coffin and the Second Line marching band sets off from the Lord Nelson and ends at the Albion on the seafront, with live music and DJ sets later in the evening.

title: Black horror double bill: Get Out and Blacula
venue: Electric Palace, 39a High Street, Hastings Old Town
summary: A Halloween double feature pairing the 1972 vampire film Blacula with Jordan Peele's Get Out, presented by the Electric Palace in collaboration with Afri-Co-Lab.

title: Hastings Embroidery exhibition
summary: Final day of the Hastings Embroidery, created in 1966 to mark the 900th anniversary of the Battle of Hastings and on display while the Bayeux Tapestry is at the British Museum. Almost 5,000 people have visited since it opened at the end of August; tickets are free to book online, with walk-ins available. A community-designed Norman banner trail also runs from Hastings Station to Hastings Castle.

title: Veterans Hub social gathering
venue: The Veterans Hub, 45 Robertson Street, Hastings
summary: Open to all, after the 11am Remembrance Day service at the war memorial in Alexandra Park.
